coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Team,
I am applying for the IT Integrations Developer position at Camping World. Since May 2020, my work at DSTax Technologies has combined software development, systems integration, project coordination, and client support. As Manager, I serve as technical lead and lead developer for a tax-integration platform, connecting business systems and helping clients implement those connections. This background aligns with your team's responsibility for developing and maintaining interfaces across enterprise applications, particularly where development work must be paired with clear communication and practical support.

At DSTax Technologies, I developed integrations between financial platforms and tax providers, including Acumatica, Chargebee, Sage Intacct, WooCommerce, Magento/Adobe Commerce, Thomson Reuters, Vertex, Sovos, and SureTax. My implementation responsibilities have included requirements gathering, setup, troubleshooting, and go-live support. I also manage internal development projects and client-coordinated work, providing integration updates, reporting status, and responding to questions and requests. This experience connects directly to Camping World's need for developers who can build interfaces and support the people using them. In a second example, I led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of our tax-integration platform, broadening support for financial platforms and tax providers while improving UI/UX. I also optimized asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput and migrated production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS. These efforts reflect experience improving an existing platform alongside ongoing integration and implementation responsibilities.

I remain interested in Camping World's IT Integrations Developer role because its combination of interface development, system improvements, and customer support closely matches the work described above. The opportunity to apply that experience across enterprise and retail systems is appealing. Thank you for considering my application; I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my integration development and platform support experience could contribute to your team.
Sincerely,
Kyle M. Anderson
reviewNotes: Emphasizes financial and web-platform integrations, implementation support, performance improvements, project communication, and POS troubleshooting. Prioritizes PHP, C#, REST APIs, Microsoft SQL Server, Git, Docker, and GitLab CI/CD. The master does not establish backend specialization, system programming or data-structure depth, Oracle, SOAP, the specified IDEs/frameworks, Agile/Waterfall methodologies, Jira/Confluence, Kubernetes, Jenkins, automated testing, or rotational on-call experience. The BBA is in Information Technology Management rather than Computer Science; hybrid-office and scheduling availability are unspecified.
